title: [ Docker Compose ] LLaMA, text-generation-webui
markdown: ### 1. LLaMa 모델 및 라이센스 확인 > ‣ Llama CLI 설치 ```bash pip install llama-stack # 이미 설치되어 있는 경우 업데이트 pip install llama-stack -U ``` 모델 목록 찾기 ```bash llama model list llama model list --show-all llama model download --source meta --model-id MODEL_ID ``` 사용자 정의 URL을 지정 ```bash https://llama3-2-lightweight.llamameta.net/*?Policy=eyJTdGF0ZW1lbnQiOlt7InVuaXF1ZV9oYXNoIjoidGlxb3Exa2FhMjMzeGp3dTBoaXhpcmhoIiwiUmVzb3VyY2UiOiJodHRwczpcL1wvbGxhbWEzLTItbGlnaHR3ZWlnaHQubGxhbWFtZXRhLm5ldFwvKiIsIkNvbmRpdGlvbiI6eyJEYXRlTGVzc1RoYW4iOnsiQVdTOkVwb2NoVGltZSI6MTc0NDI5NjEwN319fV19&Signature=PQWhITWsq8au7e0LzdiOi4LT3bsqJY6epP82%7ENvE-fQUqB9nlzYOQkIMMtVVregkLmCXnf8yovYkoICd93wMv5xsD6UrZLpZJlyHz37znvq0tV8hddlWa6PNs0AQ%7ECMc3iMyDPDRfSKq4QjUPxv5dgZdfJ%7Eu5wNcgyt8%7ErnWQrm3IgYpvLIok99uQV1aqisc9lbAaGnq0cnyGuZukfR9tqGoRYz0YueAoKQofG7x9%7EaHtvZsavzdrVqwFQgNqLpH%7EV0ERSF4%7E258f-Bem2ftlprbdlb92mpCfL-AVymUTNZkocrhPFsJpT8%7ESBTS02fU4XZhOXV-6TUCs39iEejpOg__&Key-Pair-Id=K15QRJLYKIFSLZ&Download-Request-ID=1790022548224888 ``` ### 2. text-generation-webui > ‣ LLaMA의 GPU 환경으로 제공 ### 3. Docker Compose LLaMA + Text Generation Web UI (popular setup) ```bash version: '3.8' services: llama: image: ghcr.io/oobabooga/text-generation-webui:latest ports: - "7860:7860" volumes: - ./models:/app/models environment: - MODEL=llama ``` 모델 파일은 huggingface 또는 meta에서 받은 LLaMA 파일을 ./models 폴더에 위치 ```bash docker-compose up ```
